description: This file contains the controller class for managing layout configurations within the OpenCart admin dashboard. It defines methods for listing, editing, and creating layout entries, handling HTTP requests, and preparing view data.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Controller class for managing layouts, including listing, editing, and creating layout entities within the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the layout management page, prepare breadcrumbs, load layout data, and render the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Displays a list of existing layouts with pagination and sorting options.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method that fetches and prepares the list of layouts based on current filter and sorting parameters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method that responds with the rendered list of layouts.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and renders the form for creating or editing a layout.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the layout data submitted via the form.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected layout entries.
